description: This is a PHP source file defining a class ViewCampaignconfig that extends SugarView, representing the backend logic for the campaign configuration view in the SuiteCRM EmailMan module. It manages displaying and handling campaign configuration settings, including access control, retrieving admin settings, and rendering the configuration template.

classes.name: ViewCampaignconfig
classes.description: A view class for the Campaign Configuration page in SuiteCRM's EmailMan module, providing methods for access control, preparing display data, and rendering the campaign configuration interface.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates breadcrumb navigation parameters for the module title based on the user's permissions.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Performs access control to ensure only authorized users can access the campaign configuration view.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Retrieves settings, assigns template variables, and renders the campaign configuration template for display.
